notes:
VERIFIED LIVE via raw curl + HTTP header inspection (Jul 2026), not guessed.

STRONGEST SIGNALS (all CONFIRMED live):
1. HTTP header `powered-by: Shopify` — present on allbirds.com and deathwishcoffee.com; single most reliable header signal. Standard storefronts fronted by `server: cloudflare`.
2. Inline JS bootstrap `var Shopify = Shopify || {};` then `Shopify.shop = "<store>.myshopify.com";` plus Shopify.locale, Shopify.currency, Shopify.theme{...schema_name...}. The Shopify.shop value reveals the canonical *.myshopify.com backend even on custom-domain stores — use it for detectUrlRegex/store-ID mapping.
3. Asset CDN: modern themes serve from the store's OWN domain under /cdn/shop/files/ and /cdn/shop/t/ (161+180 on allbirds, 306 on deathwishcoffee). Legacy/headless absolute form is cdn.shopify.com/s/files/... (1132 refs on gymshark). cdn.shopify.com OR same-origin /cdn/shop/ is a near-universal asset signal.
4. First-party ShopifyAnalytics + trekkie/TREKKIE inline objects carrying "shopId":<number> (verified "shopId":11044168 on allbirds), beaconing to monorail-edge.shopifysvc.com.
5. Public /products.json?limit=N returns full catalog JSON on virtually every storefront.

RENDER: SSR-static Liquid — product/collection content IS in raw HTML, so direct HTML scraping works. EXCEPTION: headless Hydrogen/Oxygen storefronts (gymshark.com CONFIRMED served via CloudFront, not Cloudflare, with NO inline window.Shopify); for those, detection must lean on cdn.shopify.com/s/files/ asset refs rather than the window.Shopify global. Hence needsHydrationCheck=true.

BADGE: The "Powered by Shopify" footer badge (span.shopify-powered-by[data-shopify="powered-by"]) is the Liquid powered_by_link default but is trivially merchant-removable and was CONFIRMED ABSENT on all 3 reference stores. Weak/optional confirming signal only; exact markup is Shopify's Liquid default (medium confidence on markup, not a live capture).

META GENERATOR: Do NOT rely on <meta name="generator">; CONFIRMED absent on all 3 modern stores. Legacy-only.

ANTI-BOT: Standard storefronts sit behind Cloudflare (can issue challenges) but plain curl with a browser UA returned HTTP 200 + full HTML on both Cloudflare-fronted stores — no challenge hit during research. Aggressive scraping may trigger rate-limits.

PRIORITY 80: .myshopify.com + inline Shopify.shop is an unambiguous dedicated backend subdomain; powered-by: Shopify header + cdn.shopify.com assets give high-reliability multi-signal confirmation even on custom domains.
